konto.telefonHinweis: A contact number for confirmed guests and for us to reach you.

konto.zahlungenHinweis: Bookings through myBestDays are paid out after your guests check out; direct bookings go to your account right away. You set up your bank details and payout schedule on the Payouts tab.
konto.inVorbereitungText: We're still building this section — it'll be available soon.
konto.faqTitel1: Why isn't my info shown here?
konto.faqText1: We hide some account details to protect your identity.
konto.faqText2: Contact and personal details can be edited. If they were used for identity verification, you'll have to verify again before your next booking or to keep hosting.
konto.faqTitel3: What info is shared with others?
konto.faqText3: Contact details of hosts and guests are only shared once a reservation is confirmed.
konto.identitaetHinweis: Confirm your identity with a government ID and a selfie.
konto.zweiFaKarteText: You need it to access important parts of your account.

konto.zweiFaCodeLabel: Enter the 6-digit code from the app
konto.zweiFaRecoveryText: Each code works once. Store them somewhere safe — they're your way in if you lose your device.
konto.geraeteBeschreibung: These are the devices currently logged in to your account. If you don't recognize one, log it out.
konto.geraeteAlleAbmelden: Log out of all other devices
konto.sharedText: Review every request carefully before you grant access.
konto.sharedKarteText: Approving a request grants full account access. That person can then act on your behalf.
konto.zweiFaIntroText: With an authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, 1Password) you generate a one-time code every time you log in. That keeps your account protected even if your password gets out.
konto.telefonCodeLabel: Confirmation code from the text message
konto.zweiFaAktivText: Your number {phone} is confirmed. When you log in from a new device, we'll ask for a code sent by text message.

konto.dsKontoLoeschenText: Request deletion of your personal data.
konto.dsBlockierteText: Blocked people can't see your profile or send you messages.

konto.waehrungHinweis: This is the currency you'll see amounts in across your account. Your listing prices stay in their own currency.
konto.azEinleitung: Your earnings are paid out after your guests check out. Until then we hold the money — that way any questions can be sorted out before anything moves.

konto.azKontoFehltText: First, save your landlord details including country and email address. Your payout account will be created automatically from this — you don't need to enter anything twice.
konto.azAktivText: Bookings through myBestDays are transferred after checkout.
konto.azFehlendeAngabenHinweis: You enter them in your business details.
konto.azRhythmusTitel: How often would you like to be paid out?
konto.azRhythmusMonatlichHinweis: By the 15th of the month after release
konto.azKarenzHinweis: Released {tage} days after checkout — that window leaves time for damages and complaints.
konto.azBankHinterlegt: On file — your payouts go to this account.
konto.azBankFehlt: No bank details on file yet.
konto.azBankLandFehlt: First enter your business's country — that determines the currency of your payouts.

konto.azBankIbanHinweis: We don't need a BIC — it's already part of the IBAN.
konto.azPostenTitel: Will be settled with your next payout
konto.utNichtAbrufbar: Your business details aren't available right now. Please try again later.
konto.utBannerText: Without {fehlend} we can't enable payments for you.
konto.utSyncFehler: The last transfer to our payment provider failed: {fehler}
konto.utEinleitung: Depending on where you are, some of these details appear on your listings. They're also used to enable payments and for your invoices.
konto.utArtGewerblich: Business — you rent out as a company.
konto.utArtPrivat: Private — you rent out as a private individual.
konto.utArtKriterien: You're generally renting out as a business if renting is your main source of income, you're entered in a commercial register or registered for sales tax, or you rent out regularly with the intention of making a profit. This status is shown to guests in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland.
konto.utPruefungHinweis: Changing details that have already been reviewed can trigger another review. Your payments stay active until it's finished.
konto.utVertretungHinweis: Needed to enable payments and not shown publicly.
konto.oaNichtGeladen: Your listing details couldn't be loaded.
konto.oaTitel: Land registry numbers for your listings
konto.oaLeerText: Once you've created a listing, you can enter its land registry number here.
konto.oaEinleitung: For listings in the EU we report the land registry or cadastral number as soon as it's available. If you don't have one, you can still submit your tax details — it has no effect on bookings or payouts.
konto.oaOffen: {anzahl, plural, one {One listing is still missing this detail.} other {# listings are still missing this detail.}}
konto.oaKeineNummerCheckbox: There is no land registry or cadastral number for this listing.
konto.sdEinleitung: When something isn't working, you can give our support team temporary insight into the technical error messages on your account. That helps us find the problem faster.
konto.sdSieht2: Browser, device and the part of the site where the error happened
konto.sdSieht3: While access is on: which pages you open and which buttons you click
konto.sdSiehtNicht1: Your entries, messages or guest data
konto.sdSiehtNicht2: What you do outside the access window — the recording ends with it
konto.sdJederzeitBeenden: You can end the access early at any time.
konto.spSperrText: Before you donate, set up how you'd like to get paid.
konto.spEinleitungFallback: Pass on part of every payout.
konto.spEinleitungZusatz: The share comes out of your payout — the platform fee isn't affected.
konto.spBeispiel: For example: {spende} on a payout of {basis} equals 3%.
konto.spLiveBeispiel: On a payout of {basis}, <stark>{spende}</stark> goes to {organisation}.
konto.spUeberGrenze: After the platform fee and any shares, at most {max}% is available.
konto.spZustimmung: By saving, you agree that the share you chose will be passed on to the organization from every future payout. You can change or stop it at any time.
konto.smsAusWarnungTotp: Logins from new devices will then only be confirmed through your authenticator app.
konto.smsAusWarnungOhne: After that, only your password protects your account. We'll no longer ask for a code when you log in from a new device.
konto.smsAusPasswortText: So nobody else can remove your second factor.
konto.sxNichtGeladen: Your tax details couldn't be loaded. Only people who may manage billing can see this section.
konto.sxInfoText: Tax details are required in most countries. As a booking platform, we're required to collect them and report them to the tax authority once a year.
konto.sxFehlendeLaender: Tax details are still missing for {laender} — you have listings there.
konto.sxUstText: If you're registered for VAT, enter your VAT identification number. It's part of your business details and is used on your invoices.
konto.sxUstLeer: No VAT identification number on file yet.
konto.sxDokumenteText: This is where you'll find the paperwork for your annual tax report in future. Your invoices and payouts are under Payments.
konto.sxDokumenteLeer: There are no tax documents yet. Reporting takes place each January for the year just ended.
konto.utArtWahlHinweis: You set the status yourself — it determines what information Stripe needs for activation. If in doubt, legal advice can help you.
konto.utArtPrivatText: You are renting out as a private person.
konto.utArtGewerblichText: You are renting out as a company or registered business.
konto.utGeburtsdatumHinweis: Required for payment activation (identity verification). Never shown publicly.
konto.utLandHinweis: Two-letter country code, e.g. DK or DE.
konto.utKennnummerHinweis: In {land}, Stripe requires a personal identification number (e.g. tax or ID number). It goes directly to Stripe and is not stored by us.
konto.utKennnummerKontoFehlt: Once your Stripe account is set up (email address and country saved), you can enter it here.
konto.seEinleitung: Guests pay myBestDays when booking. After departure, we transfer the amount to you minus our commission. For this, you need an activated Stripe account — without it, no property goes live.
konto.seSchritt1Text: Private or commercial — with name, date of birth, address and contact.
konto.seSchritt2Text: The IBAN to which your payouts go.
konto.seSchritt3Text: Accept the Stripe Connected Account Agreement once.
konto.seSchritt4Text: Stripe reviews the information — usually in minutes, at most one business day.
konto.seKontoFehlt: Your Stripe account is created automatically once your email address and country are saved in your host details.
konto.seGrundNurTos: All that's missing is your consent: Click on "Activate payments" — then the activation is complete.
konto.seGrundPastDue: Mandatory information is still missing. Open an item in the list, enter the information and save — then the activation is complete.
konto.seGrundPending: Stripe is currently reviewing your information. This usually takes a few minutes to one business day — nothing more to do here.
konto.seGrundRejected: Stripe has rejected the payment account. Please contact support.
konto.seGrundReview: Your account is currently being reviewed by Stripe. Please wait until the review is complete.
konto.seGrundSonst: Activation is not yet complete. Complete the open information and finish the setup.
konto.seZustimmungText: Payments are processed via Stripe. By clicking, you accept the <link>Stripe Connected Account Agreement</link>; myBestDays acts as the platform.
konto.seFeldMccHinweis: myBestDays sets automatically (accommodation industry) — if it remains open, please contact support.
konto.seFeldUnbekannt: Unknown request from Stripe — please contact support.
konto.seHinweisAusweis: Cannot be uploaded here yet — please contact support.
konto.ksEinleitung: Here you can see where your money currently is: what myBestDays still holds per booking, what is already in your Stripe account, and what has been transferred to your bank.
konto.ksWeg1: The guest pays myBestDays when booking.
konto.ksWeg2: myBestDays holds the amount until {tage} days after departure.
konto.ksWeg3: Then we transfer it to your Stripe account, minus commission.
konto.ksWeg4: Stripe pays it out to your bank at the chosen frequency.
konto.ksKeinKonto: No Stripe account yet — please set up payments first.
konto.ksNichtAbrufbar: Currently unavailable. Please try again later.

objektEditor.barriereMGuestEntranceWiderThan32InchesT: The entrance door is at least 32 inches wide, so a wheelchair fits through.
objektEditor.barriereMDisabledParkingSpotText: A designated accessible parking spot for guests with disabilities is available near the entrance.
objektEditor.barriereMWellLitPathToEntranceText: The path to the guest entrance is lit along its whole length at night, so steps and obstacles are easy to spot.
objektEditor.barriereMStepFreeBedroomAccessText: There are no steps or thresholds higher than 2 inches leading to the bedroom; it's at ground level or reachable by elevator or ramp.
objektEditor.barriereMBedroomEntranceWiderThan32Inche: The bedroom door is at least 32 inches wide, so a wheelchair fits through.
objektEditor.barriereMStepFreeBathroomAccessText: There are no steps or thresholds higher than 2 inches leading to the bathroom; it's reachable at ground level.
objektEditor.barriereMBathroomEntranceWiderThan32Inch: The bathroom door is at least 32 inches wide, so a wheelchair fits through.
objektEditor.barriereMToiletGrabBarText: A firmly mounted grab bar next to the toilet gives support when sitting down and standing up.
objektEditor.barriereMShowerGrabBarText: A firmly mounted grab bar in the shower gives support while showering.
objektEditor.barriereMStepFreeShowerText: The shower is level with the floor, with no step or threshold, so it can be rolled into with a wheelchair or shower chair.
objektEditor.barriereMShowerOrBathChairText: A shower or bath chair is available, so guests can shower or bathe sitting down.
objektEditor.barriereMCeilingOrMobileHoistText: A ceiling hoist or mobile patient lift is available, for example to move guests from a wheelchair into bed or the shower.
objektEditor.barriereMPoolOrHotTubHoistText: A fixed or mobile hoist makes it possible to get in and out of the pool or hot tub.

kalender.editorHilfe2: Set price changes, discounts, and availability rules.
kalender.editorHilfe3: Select the travel dates and objects in the calendar to which the rule should apply.
kalender.editorInfo_preis_text: Changes the nightly rate by a percentage — up or down. The change applies to every night you assign the rule set to in the calendar and is calculated before discounts.
kalender.editorInfo_dauer_text: A length of stay discount applies from the chosen number of nights and beyond: "Weekly" from 7 nights, "Monthly" from 28. If more than one tier applies, the longer one is used.
kalender.editorInfo_lastminute_text: Applies to bookings made shortly before arrival. You can create multiple tiers — the closer the arrival, the higher the discount. The guest only sees the final price, not the discount.
kalender.editorInfo_fruehbucher_text: Applies to bookings made far in advance, specified in months before arrival. Multiple tiers are possible. The guest only sees the final price, not the discount.
kalender.editorInfo_laenge_text: Minimum and maximum stay for the days of this rule set. The minimum stay can also be set per arrival day — for example, seven nights for Saturday arrivals, three for all other days.
kalender.editorInfo_tage_text: Weekdays on which neither arrival nor departure is allowed during this period. The block applies to all channels, including portals.

kalender.einstBasispreisUnterzeile: Applies to any night without its own price
kalender.richtlinie_flexibel_1: Guests receive a full refund up to 1 day before arrival
kalender.richtlinie_flexibel_2: After that, the first night's fee is retained
kalender.richtlinie_moderat_1: Guests receive a full refund up to 5 days before arrival
kalender.richtlinie_moderat_2: Within 5 days, no refund will be issued
kalender.richtlinie_eingeschraenkt_1: Guests receive a full refund up to 14 days before arrival
kalender.richtlinie_eingeschraenkt_2: Between 14 and 7 days, 50% is refunded, after that nothing
kalender.stornoNichtErstattbarText: Guests get nothing back if they cancel. You keep the full payout, even if they cancel.
kalender.richtlinie_lang_moderat_1: Guests receive a full refund up to 30 days before arrival.
kalender.richtlinie_lang_moderat_2: After that, there is no refund.
kalender.richtlinie_lang_streng_1: Guests receive a full refund up to 28 days before arrival.
kalender.richtlinie_lang_streng_2: After that, there is no refund.
kalender.richtlinie_flexibel_info: If a guest cancels within 1 day of arrival, they are charged 1 night. If they cancel during their stay, they are charged 1 additional night and the remainder is refunded.
kalender.richtlinie_moderat_info: If a guest cancels within 5 days of arrival or after check-in, they are charged 1 additional night; 50% of the remaining nights are refunded.
kalender.richtlinie_eingeschraenkt_info: Guests who cancel 7 to 14 days before arrival receive 50% back. After that, the booking is non-refundable.
kalender.richtlinie_lang_moderat_info: If a guest cancels within 30 days of arrival, there is no refund. If they cancel during their stay, the first 30 nights are retained.
kalender.richtlinie_lang_streng_info: If a guest cancels within 28 days of arrival, there is no refund. If they cancel during their stay, the first 30 nights are retained.
